title: Advanced Manual Schema Builder
description: Manual Mode is the advanced schema builder in Syntrix. It is designed for users who already know the dataset structure they want and need full control over how the data should be generated. Instead of asking Syntrix to infer the schema automatically, the user manually defines every field, data type, distribution, category, constraint, correlation, relation, row count, seed, and export format.

use_case.target_user: Advanced users, QA engineers, data engineers, product teams, and data scientists
use_case.purpose: Create exact, repeatable, configurable synthetic datasets without writing code.

correlations.description: Employees with more experience usually have higher salaries. This is a statistical relationship, not a hard rule.
Older employees usually have more years of experience.

relations.description: Job titles should be logically consistent with the selected department.
Experience years should not exceed age minus 18.
Employees with lower performance scores are more likely to be marked as Probation or Terminated.

expected_output_summary.goal: Generate a controlled synthetic dataset from a manually configured schema.
expected_capabilities: Allow the user to define every column manually
Support string, integer, float, category, date, and boolean data types
Support uniform, normal, categorical, and functional distributions
Allow exact categories for categorical fields
Apply nullable, unique, min, and max constraints
Generate the requested number of rows
Export the dataset in the selected format

validation_layer.purpose: Validate the user-defined schema before generation to ensure the dataset configuration is complete, consistent, and safe to execute.
checks: All feature names must be valid
Each feature must include a supported data type
Numeric fields must include valid min and max values when required
Categorical fields must include allowed categories
Correlation definitions must reference existing numeric fields
Relation rules must reference existing fields
Hard rules must be logically valid
Seed must be accepted for reproducibility

user_role: Selects row count, seed, and export format
syntrix_role: Generates rows according to the user-defined schema
llm_role: Optional assistance for explaining schema issues
Optional guidance when the user wants help configuring fields
deterministic_layer_role: Acts as the source of reliability
Ensures output follows the configured schema
